_comment: Hand-authored Chinese word -> topic map. Topic assignments are original work for this project (MIT). Headwords: HSK 1-6 from glxxyz/hskhsk.com (MIT); HSK 7-9 band + frequency ranks from drkameleon/complete-hsk-vocabulary (MIT) <- elkmovie/hsk30 (MIT). Only headword, level and frequency rank are taken from those sources - no definitions, pinyin, examples or audio. Regenerate the runtime table with `npm run build:topics`.
